# CB Marquee Characters

> Light-up marquee letter and number rentals for weddings, birthdays and events in Sydney and across Cape Breton, Nova Scotia. $50 per character plus HST for up to 24 hours; $25 delivery, set-up and pick-up in the Sydney area. Phone 902-537-1074.

CB Marquee Characters is a marquee letter rental business at 165 Cabot St, Sydney, NS, Canada. The 3-foot letters and 4-foot numbers are built and painted by hand in Sydney, fitted with warm bulbs, and delivered, set up and picked up by the person who built them.

## Key facts

- Letters: 3 feet tall, about 2 feet wide. Numbers: 4 feet tall. Painted white, warm bulbs.
- Price: $50 per character (letters, numbers, ampersand) plus HST, for up to 24 hours.
- Delivery, set-up and pick-up: $25 in the Sydney area; quoted for the rest of Cape Breton Island.
- Service area: Sydney, Glace Bay, North Sydney, Sydney Mines, New Waterford, Membertou, Westmount, Coxheath and the Cape Breton Regional Municipality; Baddeck, Louisbourg, Port Hawkesbury and elsewhere on Cape Breton Island by quote.
- Needs on site: a regular outlet and a safe, flat surface, indoors or outdoors.
- Reviews: rated 5.0 on Google (3 reviews as of October 2026).
